verdict.rationale: WooCommerce documents a REST API that lets WC data be created, read, updated, and deleted. It adds a Store API for cart and checkout, a WC-CLI for store management, and native MCP support, so a broad programmatic surface clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that this surface matches everything the dashboard UI can do. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or coverage map, evidence that settings, extensions, and admin-only actions are reachable via the API, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
